e0fdbe92033753f4.title: Lipid elongation as a hallmark of aging
digest: Li and colleagues identify lipid acyl chain elongation as a conserved hallmark of aging across tissues and species.
Genetic shortening of lipid chains extends lifespan in worms, which establishes chain length as a causal contributor to aging.

2747078c02d4ca39.title: Life Biosciences share glaucoma study updates for its cellular reprogramming drug

abcba21cbb7edff9.title: Lymph node contraction links sex-biased naive CD8+ T cell decline to compromised antigen recognition during middle age
digest: Menzel and colleagues report that male mice and humans undergo accelerated immune aging, characterized by naive CD8+ T cell decline and early thymic involution, which impairs cancer antigen recognition and response to immunotherapy.

5b3768662a723e1c.title: High-throughput metabolic engineering in mammalian cells
digest: Engineering complex phenotypes into mammalian cells holds profound potential but remains a largely intractable engineering challenge.
We developed shotgun genetic engineering (SGE), a multiplexed strategy that screens millions of combinatorial solutions in a single experiment.
